ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to high-intensity (white) pixels. Dark pixels cover approximately 90% of the visible surface area, with white pixels concentrated at the peduncle base and in sparse specks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-intensity white focal point at the junction of the fluke and peduncle. Micro-mottling of white pixels is visible throughout the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped notch with an acute angle estimated at 35 degrees; the depth of the notch extends significantly into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe: High-frequency, high-amplitude saw-tooth peaks on the distal half. Left lobe: Low-frequency, irregular erosion-style peaks; edge appears more worn and less uniform than the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edges with a steep upward sweep toward the tips. The right lobe trailing edge follows a relatively straight diagonal line, while the left lobe trailing edge displays a more concave, irregular trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distributed high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (potential barnacle scars) scattered across the right lobe medial surface. High density of white speckling on the lower right quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct linear disruptions; a prominent diagonal white line is visible on the inner-mid region of the right lobe. Three parallel vertical linear marks visible on the left lobe distal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced tissue irregularity and jagged erosion along the left lobe trailing edge compared to the relatively intact right lobe edge. Visible rake-mark patterns on the left lobe medial surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe distal tip features a uniquely large, isolated serration peak set apart from the primary trailing edge sequence.
